decisions.reason: Although it builds on the firm's advisory capabilities, it is less tied to its core recycling machinery and manufacturing knowledge, giving the firm lower absorptive capacity for this service and a somewhat higher risk of pruning.

It extends the firm's waste-to-material expertise into adjacent bio-based binder production, and the firm's own R&D and university cooperation support learning and improvement, making withdrawal unlikely.
The plant is close to the firm's core modular machinery and waste-treatment capabilities, so the firm can readily interpret results and improve the product, making a drop very unlikely.
